messages:
Sam (Partners): Quick sync — putting together the partner-facing playbook for Marketplace Terraform modules. Goal: partner smoke tests + CI by next Wed. Who can own the module packaging + example stacks? :calendar:

Maria (Eng): I can own the module layout and examples. Are we publishing module registry artifacts or just bundles in the marketplace listing? Need to know expectations for inputs/outputs.

Lee (Infra): For CI, we'll add a GitHub Actions smoke job that runs a minimal deploy/destroy against a sandbox account. I can drop a snippet. We should gate on terraform fmt & validate too.

Olivia (Product): Marketplace requires a bundled asset (templates + docs) and a short deploy walkthrough. Also legal wants the license checked before listing. I'll track the docs side.

Ben (CloudPartner): From partner side: we can run the smoke test in our account once you give the module source + sample vars. Timing works for us next Tue/Wed.

Maria (Eng): Working assumptions:
- module namespace: `redwood/marketplace/refarch`
- minimal example: VPC + single GPU instance + service that points to Redwood Dedicated endpoint
- variables: region, instance_type, key_pair, redwood_model_id

Lee (Infra): Example GH Actions job:
```yaml
name: smoke
on: [push]
jobs:
  smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - name: terraform fmt
        run: terraform fmt -check
      - name: terraform init
        run: terraform init
      - name: terraform apply
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve
      - name: run smoke curl
        run: curl -sS $ENDPOINT/health
      - name: terraform destroy
        if: always()
        run: terraform destroy -auto-approve
``` 
We'll add secrets via repo settings: TF_VAR_key_pair, AWS_ACCOUNT_SANDBOX.

Sam (Partners): @Maria (Eng) — that namespace is fine. Can you add a short `deploy_demo.sh` that wraps `terraform apply` with example envs? Partners prefer one-click-ish.

Maria (Eng): Yep. I'll add `examples/demo/README.md` and `deploy_demo.sh`. Demo will inject a placeholder `redwood_model_id = "redwood/gpt-small"` so partners can swap.

Olivia (Product): I'll draft the marketplace README with screenshots and a 3-step install. Also adding license check to the PR checklist.

Ben (CloudPartner): We'll run the GH Actions in our fork first. Also: expose an output `endpoint_url` so the partner console can link directly to the deployed endpoint.

Maria (Eng): Good call — adding outputs:
```
outputs = {
  endpoint_url = module.service.endpoint
  instance_id = module.instance.id
}
```

deploy-bot: CI status — branch `marketplace-iac/playbook` — smoke job passed (ubuntu-latest) — 2m 18s :white_check_mark:

Lee (Infra): Nice. Action items:
- Maria: module + examples + deploy script (owner)
- Lee: GH Actions template + secrets guide (owner)
- Olivia: marketplace README + license check (owner)
- Ben: partner run + feedback by Tue EOD (owner: Ben)

Sam (Partners): Can everyone update the thread with PR links when ready? I'll assemble the partner-facing slide deck and include the smoke checklist. :rocket:

Ben (CloudPartner): Will post fork PR once smoke run completes.

Maria (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-modules/pull/82 — includes examples/demo and deploy_demo.sh

Lee (Infra): Added Actions workflow in PR — `ci/smoke.yml` — added secrets doc at `docs/ci-secrets.md`.

Olivia (Product): Draft README at `docs/marketplace/README.md` and license flagged to legal (tracking ticket RWD-423).

Sam (Partners): Great progress. Plan: dry-run partner demo on Wed 10:00 PT. I'll send calendar invite. Thanks all. :clap:
